advisory.finding: _terraform_paths_from_finding scans finding['evidence'] strings through _file_from_location, but the sibling plan-review seam (terraform_seam._iter_cited_paths) deliberately does NOT scan evidence — evidence is free-form prose and _file_from_location splits on the first ':' , so 'See config at path: infra/main.tf' parses to 'See config at path' and is dropped, silently missing a real .tf citation.
